epics.title: Runtime Environment Initialization Repair
epics.jtbd: When the end customer attempts to launch the application, I want the system to start successfully without network conflicts, so that the product is actually available for use.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the application launch failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Fix DNS resolution for host.docker.internal in the deployment environment so the health check succeeds.
R2: Fix permission denied error for backup.sh script so the backup service starts successfully.

slices.title: Fix host.docker.internal resolution and backup.sh execution permissions in deployment configuration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the network configuration and backup script permission fixes for this epic, I want the health check to successfully resolve the backend container and the backup service to start successfully, so that the application launch completes without errors.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh deployment environment,
When the application is launched and the health check executes,
Then it resolves host.docker.internal correctly and the launch completes without NameResolutionError.
Given a fresh deployment environment,
When the application is launched and the backup service starts,
Then backup.sh executes correctly without permission denied errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce the occurrence of NameResolutionError and permission denied errors during application launch from 100% to 0%
